about_the_game:
Rush N Crash is an exciting kart racing game where humans and zombies battle it out in intense competitions. With both single-player and upcoming multiplayer modes, players experience a unique blend of skills, strategy, and adrenaline-pumping action.

Key Features:

  • Single & Multiplayer Modes (Coming Soon): Sharpen your skills in a story-driven single-player campaign, or challenge opponents in online multiplayer races once it's available.

  • Fast-Paced, Competitive Gameplay: Boost your speed, outmaneuver rivals, or use defensive tactics to dominate on dynamic and unpredictable tracks.

  • Unique Game Modes:

    • Challenge Mode: Survive within a time limit in high-stakes races.

    • Savior Mode: Complete rescue missions while staying alive against all odds.

  • Character Selection & Customization (Coming Soon): Choose between human and zombie factions, express your style with unique skins, and join the race in your own way.

  • Strategic Power-Ups:

    • Available Now: Use concept-based abilities to gain an edge against zombie threats.

    • Coming Soon: Surprise your opponents with rockets, barriers, and phasing power-ups.

  • Vibrant Visuals & Dynamic Soundtrack: Cartoon-style graphics and immersive music bring the racing chaos to life.

Note: All features related to online/multiplayer modes are planned for future updates. Timelines will be announced to players accordingly.
